text:
jordan: FYI observed mismatch between per-call billing and token usage when micro-batching is active. Looks like several tenants are being overcharged when requests are collapsed.

priya: saw this in a few customer tickets today. Mostly small-embedding workloads where one big batch was attributed entirely to a single tenant.

mikko: brief runtime note: we coalesce by model+quant+seq_len_bucket and currently emit a single physical trace for the batch. We do have trace.batch_id and trace.batch_size, but not per-tenant breakdown.

jeffrey: (cc @leah) is this mostly a routing/capacity optimization side-effect?

leah: yup. The scheduler fills free GPU slots with any compatible request. Cheap for latency but messy for billing.

jordan: proposal idea: add a compact, optional field to the batch trace called `batch.attribution_summary`. It's an array of small kv pairs: [{billing_key: "b:acme", tokens: 42}, {billing_key: "b:beta", tokens:8}] but we must support privacy mode where billing_key is hashed/opaque.

priya: prefer `billing_key` naming so ingest can map to customer accounts. For privacy opt-out we replace with `billing_fingerprint` and a salt version.

mikko: runtime perf constraints: adding a long per-item list will increase trace size and serialization. Suggest we limit to per-tenant token counts (no request ids) and cap items at e.g., 64 entries. If overflow -> emit `batch.truncated=true` and a fallback token_total.

eva: ingest side: we can expand summary into per-tenant aggregation without storing full per-request logs. Plan: on ingest transform, convert batch.attribution_summary -> emit a short metric event per tenant with tokens delta and reference to batch_ts. That keeps queryability and low-cardinality in main trace table.

jordan: nice. Also need to handle legacy cases where summary is absent. Fallback logic: use request.headers.request_size_estimate and proportionally split by estimated tokens. Documented as `ingest.split_fallback=proportional`.

priya: about retention: store attribution_summaries in raw trace store for 30d, but index only billing_key -> aggregated tokens per day to keep search fast. We should also offer an opt-in longer retention for enterprise.

mikko: operationally we should ensure the runtime feature is behind a flag (`runtime.emit_attribution_summaries`) so we can enable for Dedicated/customers and canary forHosted.

ops-bot: Rolling canary: /deploy runtime v2 --feature=emit_attribution_summaries --canary=5% scheduled 2025-06-12T03:00Z

leah: QA notes: check worst-case payload size, check latency p95 on microbatch path <+5ms delta, ensure we don't increase GC churn.

jordan: security: keys going into telemetry must be either stable hashed tokens (HMAC with per-region salt) or mapped to internal billing ids at the edge and never present downstream. Add option: `runtime.attribution_mode = [plain,billed_hash,edge_mapped]`.

priya: follow-up RFC items I'll put together: 1) schema change `batch.attribution_summary` format + limits, 2) privacy modes and hashing spec, 3) ingest transform pseudocode + fallback, 4) retention & indexing plan, 5) rollout plan + telemetry tests.

mikko: add: failure modes & monitoring. If batch.summary present but sum(tokens) != batch.token_total -> emit `ingest.attr_inconsistent` alert and route to debug sink.

eva: ops playbook: how to reconcile retroactive invoices if mis-attributed? We need a query to recompute per-tenant tokens from raw traces for last 90 days before we start enforcement.

jordan: action items: Priya -> draft RFC (ETA 2 business days). Mikko -> prototype runtime emitter (small PoC) and perf numbers. Eva -> ingest transform + dashboard for attr_inconsistent alert. Leah -> perf guardrails and QA checklist.

priya: I'll also include an example payload in the RFC, something like:
```json
{
  "trace.id":"t-abc",
  "batch.id":"b-0001",
  "batch.token_total":50,
  "batch.attribution_summary":[{"billing_key":"b:acme","tokens":42},{"billing_key":"b:beta","tokens":8}],
  "batch.truncated":false
}
```

mikko: perfect. Keep the array tiny and numeric-only where possible. No free-text tenant names.

jordan: final note: this reduces charge disputes and improves observability for multi-tenant bursts. We'll sync in tomorrow's infra sync (10:00).
